name: shader-grain-gradient
title: Shader Grain Gradient
description: A grainy multi-stop gradient shape drifts slowly under film-grain texture: an analog, premium WebGL backdrop in any palette and one of seven shapes.
useWhen: A gradient backdrop needs analog texture: the grain reads as film or print rather than flat digital.
The tone is premium and editorial and the motion should stay subtle.
The field should be quieter: raise `softness` and `noise`.
avoidWhen: You need crisp, clean color with no texture: use shader-mesh-gradient.
Foreground text is tiny: heavy grain lowers contrast, so lower `intensity` and `noise` or use a solid backdrop.
You want structured geometry: use shader-dot-orbit or shader-voronoi.
You want a finished look without choosing colors: use a preset such as shader-grain-gradient-sunrise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 7 colors, comma separated, from the edge of the shape to its core.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the shape drifts. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How softly the colors blend. 0 gives hard bands.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: How strongly the grain distorts the shape.

variables.label: Noise
variables.description: Amount of grain speckle over the colors.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the gradient in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster but coarsens the grain.
